title: Acceptance of the top class's own work on claude-fable-5-2: the model note stops effort at high where matrix row 4 says xhigh
brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: Claude Code desktop app. The harness reports this session's model as claude-fable-5-2 at effort high.
The session usage tool reports tokensUsed 150,000, contextWindow 1,000,000 and autoCompactsAtPercent 97. This session has not been compacted.
A fresh session in this harness and project starts at 86,450 tokens (measured: the usage tool's total less its Messages category).

Next stage: adversarial acceptance of the cost model this session wrote earlier today: re-derive it by hand, recompute every figure, argue against each assumption. Fable is the top class this harness offers. Plan estimate: 12 turns. Expected fresh input 5,000 tokens per turn and output 3,000 per turn (estimates).
A fresh session would read 30,000 tokens: the cost model, its inputs and the handoff.
A handoff for this stage would be about 80 lines. If a further acceptance session were used, it would take about 12 turns and read about 30,000 tokens.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
If the plan includes a fresh session, the operator starts it from a card this session proposes and receives its note, verifies it and merges it; this session ends after writing the handoff.
The usage report shows every cache write in this session as a 1-hour write.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
notes: Added in Stage S7 (2026-11-12) with the model note models/claude-fable-5-2.md. It is scenario 09 on claude-fable-5-2, under formula 2026-11-11 and table pricing/2026-11-10.json, with To 0 and the 1-hour cache lifetime stated. Figures captured from the calculator (node scripts/dispatch.mjs --json) on 2026-11-12; T* = 1.963 / (33,550 x 0.2e-6) = 292.6 turns.

T* is far above 12, so the draft is continue by break-even, as in scenario 09. Guardrail 6 then makes the verdict fresh: the author is the top class, so acceptance runs on claude-fable-5-2 in a fresh session.

The effort is what this scenario tests. Matrix row 4 says xhigh when the author is the top class. The model note (step 1.4.6) replaces that effort cell on claude-fable-5-2: start at high and go above it only on a measurement on the same task type. A subject that reads the note states high; a subject that does not states xhigh. The sandbox carries models/ for this reason (eval/run.mjs SKILL_ENTRIES).

To 0: the operator starts the next session from a card and this session ends. No coordinator. The block must state To 0, no coordinator and ttl 1h (rubric section 2). The other 24 scenarios name no claude-fable-5-2, so the note does not apply to them and their expectations do not change.
